## Products

Software Codelix designs, builds and runs itself, alongside client work.

- [Audytee](https://www.codelixitsolutions.com/products/audytee): Practice management software for chartered accountant (CA) firms — clients, tasks, compliance calendar, invoicing and billing. Live at https://audytee.com. Plans: Starter ₹499/month, Professional ₹1,999/month, Business ₹4,999/month, all plus GST.
- [4bitx](https://www.codelixitsolutions.com/products/4bitx): Custom ERP — a manufacturing operating system for Indian SMEs, from the factory floor to finance, with GST e-invoice and e-way bill integration. Used in manufacturing, construction, ceramics, CNC and engineering, brass and metal, textiles, packaging and fabrication. Live at https://4bitx.com. One-time setup from ₹2.5 lakh, plus an annual maintenance contract.
- [AanganOne](https://www.codelixitsolutions.com/products/aanganone): Society, apartment and community management app for residents, admins, committee members and security guards — visitor entry through to maintenance billing. Live on Google Play; submitted to the Apple App Store. https://aanganone.com
